{{Quote|Come see spectacular Teyr Rift. Then go home.|Popular unofficial tourism motto|<ref name="SoL" />}}
'''Teyr''' was a bureaucratic and tourism [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Surric system]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Everything's wrong. This isn't our kind of world. It's everything we're trying not to be. It's too crowded, too loud, too organized and artificial. If they were ever here, they wouldn't have stayed very long.|[[Akanah Norand Goss Pell|Akanah]], about Teyr and the [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]]|<ref name="SoL" />}}
Teyr was a bureaucratic world, 34 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] from [[Vulvarch]]. It was located near the juncture of three busy spaceways,<ref name="SoL" /> including the [[Shipwrights' Trace/Legends|Shipwrights' Trace]].<ref name="TEA" />

It was a popular tourist destination, known for its majestic [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] and the breathtaking [[Teyr Rift]]. Thousands of cruise ships, [[Yacht/Legends|yachts]], and other tourist vessels arrived daily at overcrowded orbital facilities from which passengers were ferried down to the planet. The [[Rift Skyrail]] connected all Teyr's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] with all major population centers and resort destinations in the Rift Territory.<ref name="SoL" />

The [[Mobquet Presents: Fastest Land Beings]] race was held on Teyr.<ref name="HNN52">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|sports/13418_1.html|New Galaxy's Fastest Hexaped}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|What about Ganner?''"<br />"''He's from Teyr&mdash;he wouldn't know odds from groats. He's good in a fight, though, and smart when he thinks before acting. And handsome, too, as you've probably noticed.|Jaina Solo and Corran Horn|<ref name="Ruin" />}}
[[File:Teyr.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Battle of Teyr]].]]

The planet was colonized by at least [[496 BBY]].

Just before the Clone Wars, the [[Mobquet Presents: Fastest Land Beings]] race was held in the major city of [[Pyre Folas]] on Teyr. It was sponsored by landspeeder manufacturer [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet Swoops and Speeders]].<ref name="HNN52">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|sports/13418_1.html|New Galaxy's Fastest Hexaped}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was the site of the [[Battle of Teyr]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], which was led by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]].<ref name="JMW">''[[Jedi: Mace Windu]]''</ref>

By [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], Teyr was one of the New Republic's boom worlds. Fearing unbridled growth, Teyr's leaders created the [[Citizen Services Corps]] and tried to discourage immigrants with a maze of regulations. During the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his companion [[Akanah Norand Goss Pell|Akanah]] traveled to the planet seeking traces of the [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]].<ref name="SoL" />

[[Ganner Rhysode]], a member of the [[New Jedi Order]], was from Teyr.<ref name="Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref>
